summary: Depths. One click focuses and a double click opens on the Field too (the board and the tree already did); her hand's go.open by the pointer double-clicks. A working view opened from the board, the tree or Search shows "Board" at the left of the breadcrumb (back to the board on the same object at the zoom and place it had, through L1's history; Forward comes back to the view). The centre bar gains Save and Return (save, close, the board), Full program (S2's default app through apps.open, or for an Office sheet the Office's own reviewed edit copy) and Close; closing such a view with changes not saved asks Save, Don't save, Cancel, and closing it (also by its tab) comes back to the board instead of Home. A line under the centre bar says what happened to the view's file: every open file is watched (QFileSystemWatcher); a clean view is reloaded with "Reloaded: ... at hh:mm"; a dirty one is left as it is with Compare (line by line in words; a sheet: the cells that differ), Keep yours and Take the one on disk; an Office sheet saved elsewhere is reloaded or flagged when its view or the window comes to the front. Each new revision of a file in Files (another program, or the full program on its return) is recorded through new Kernel operations revisions.record (execute; the Kernel reads the file and records only the bytes named: verified on disk) and revisions.list (read, observer), plus a files.save activity event; the board then shows the file's revision and wires it "saved again" to the admitted source holding its earlier bytes, marking that source and the settled things resting on it RECHECK. Acceptance: bench readings opened from the board, B3 changed, Save and Return -> the board, same focus and zoom, both calculations CALC • RECHECK; an outside edit to the open clean bench_log.txt reloads with its line. Smoke: graphite 48/48, kasandra 38/38 OK.

decisions: Where the controls live: "Board" is a small button at the left of L1's breadcrumb bar, shown only at work depth (the coordinator's words); Save and Return, Full program and Close are added at the end of the existing centre bar after its own Save (Save stays the bar's). At a narrow centre (under 1000 px, icons chosen: 1366x768) Full program is its glyph alone so the name of what is open keeps its room.

Going back: when the board entry of the same object is just before the view's entry in L1's history, Board / Close / Save and Return use L1's Back (Forward then reopens the view); otherwise a new board place on the object with the board state (zoom, place, board or whole desk) of the board entry the view was opened from. A view opened from the whole desk goes back to the whole desk.

Which closings come back to the board: a view opened through the navigation (it carries L1's _living_oid: the board, the tree, Search) closed by its tab or by Close / Save and Return, and any view closed by Close / Save and Return. Other tabs keep their old asks and Home when the last closes. Only those views use the new ask (Save, Don't save, Cancel); pages that save themselves (Documents) are saved, never asked about.

Recording a revision: any file in Files whose bytes change while it is open in a view (another program, or the full program started from the view) is recorded through new Kernel ops revisions.record (execute; the Kernel reads the whole file and refuses unless the digest on disk is the one named; files outside Files are refused) and revisions.list (read, observer); each record is also a files.save activity event, as file_delivery records Graphite's own saves. The revision seen first becomes revision 1. A file outside Files is reloaded, not recorded.

Marking dependants: the board (L2's Desk) reads revisions.list; an admitted source whose SHA-256 is an earlier revision of a file of the same name is wired to the file "saved again" (recheck), marked SOURCE • RECHECK with "a newer revision is in Files", its outgoing wires marked recheck, and the settled things resting on it directly (sheet, calculation, finding, page in a current or supported state) marked RECHECK. A refuted finding or an open question keeps its own word (truth is marked apart). Nothing is written to their records and nothing is brought into Intake: that stays the owner's.

Full program for an Office sheet (a Kernel record, not a file): the Office's own reviewed route (Prepare edit copy, Open editor, Review file under More); its new revision then comes through candidate.commit and the calculations go RECHECK by the existing source_state path.

Return from the full program is seen three ways: the file watcher (a save), the program's process ending (session_launch.start_time; one that ends within 4 s is taken as a hand-over to one already running, as LibreOffice does, and the watcher goes on), and Graphite's window becoming active again.

A dirty view whose file changed on disk is never reloaded: the line offers Compare, Keep yours (the next Save writes over the disk's; for a sheet, the newer version becomes its base) and Take the one on disk (an editor's text is kept as a recovery copy first).
The editor's current-line band was a fixed light colour (#f2e9da) that hid the line's words in both dark looks (seen in my outside-edit frames); it is now the look's RAISED (qt_app, one marked line).

Her hand's go.open on a Field sheet by the pointer sends a double click now (desk_doers), so the existing go.open {sheet} acts (test_desk_acts) stay true under the new one-click rule; the smoke ran it (B10).

For A1 (programs by window and file): depths_qt.Depths.full_program / look / record are the route (opened on the owner's press through apps.open, watched by file, process and window activation, recorded through revisions.record, the board marks through depths.mark_board); S3's window list could replace the process test for "its window closed".

For K2 (tools and receipts): revisions.record is a verified-effect operation (it reads the bytes on disk before recording; REVISIONS_NOT_ON_DISK otherwise), usable as the receipt of "the new revision is on disk".
For L5 (tabs and the split): return_target treats work and split entries alike; the Board control shows whenever the workspace is in front.
The whole-desk Field (field_source) does not read revisions: a source marked RECHECK on the board because its file was saved again is still CURRENT on the whole desk.
Window checks (not run): a tools/check_*_ui.py that clicks a Field sheet once expecting it to open would now need a double click; none was found by a search of tools/ and tests_integrated/.
revisions.record is execute scope, so her principal can call it; it records only bytes the Kernel reads on disk, never a claim; not put in ALWAYS_ASKS.

release_note: Depths: one click focuses, a double click opens an object's working view in the centre (sheet, page, calculation, reference, picture, question, text); "Board" at the left of the breadcrumb goes back to the same board at the same zoom; Save and Return saves and closes; closing with unsaved changes asks Save, Don't save or Cancel. A file changed by another program while it is open is noticed at once: a clean view reloads with a line saying so, a view with unsaved changes offers Compare, Keep yours or Take the one on disk. Full program opens the file in its default app; when it saves, the new revision is recorded (checked on disk) and the board marks what rested on the earlier revision for a recheck.
